beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Simple-mode course drops can turn videos into work samples, with a video header and Google Drive upload. Links in PDFs can be opened from Verify.
• Finalized-student Schoology badges name the assignments waiting for grading and open directly to those submissions.
• PCA work-sample connection controls are available in both Simple and Advanced mode. Desktop importing requires administrator-provided API setup; live PCA search and download have not yet been validated.

Fixes:
• Fixed refresh and settings crashes and improved recovery when AI or a connected folder is unavailable.
• Fixed Missing Schoology placeholders appearing as unposted submissions waiting for pre-grade.
• Fixed PCA extension samples being blocked from being sent again after deletion.
• Improved import matching and cancellation handling to preserve existing work and ignore results from canceled uploads.
• Preserved accompanying documents when rebuilding a video work-sample header.
• Show in folder now selects the current document in Finder.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• macOS builds now bundle PyQt6-Qt6 6.11.2, preventing the Qt WaitCursor crash caused by QTBUG-147602.

Fixes:
• Fixed a macOS crash when the app showed the wait cursor.
